question: Do the already frozen BBC1-S2 Boltz2 pTM/avg_lDDT shadow coefficients predict quantitative folding-stability changes beyond a no-effect baseline on an independent, blinded, nonhomologous assay dataset?

source_truth_gate.pass_condition: Obtain and pin original raw BBC1 CSV, map all eight sequence+mutation pairs uniquely, compare exact ddG_ML_float to processed labels within 1e-9, record original dataset version and SHA. Any mismatch triggers HOLD, not sign flipping/retuning.

mirrored_raw_evidence.requirement: Resolve exactly which ProteinGym source version / raw experimental transformation produced processed W38L. Do not retrofit legacy model or claim full primary-source audit.
mirrored_raw_evidence.reconciliation: SUPERSEDED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONE_PER_MUT_TYPE_IS_INSUFFICIENT; all published 2069 scores match when grouped on aa_seq.

original_author_zenodo_2023_evidence.attempts: First direct HTTP range extraction succeeded; later independent automated range replay encountered HTTP 504, retain HOLD on full-source digest.
original_author_zenodo_2023_evidence.source_reconciliation_procedure: Investigate and reproduce ProteinGym preprocessing at six positions F10,W38,Y39,D45,N47,E57; do not select sign/scale/offset based on previous holdout performance.
original_author_zenodo_2023_evidence.resolution: PROTEINGYM_COMBINES_ALIASED_AUTHOR_CONSTRUCT_ROWS_WITH_IDENTICAL_TERMINAL_AMINO_ACID_SEQUENCE; direct 2023 single raw W38L remains -1.0025844433957378, but DMS_score -0.8445540655216376 is mean across W38L and F10F:W38L; these are not contradictory measurements of the same raw record.

exact_reconstruction.mechanism: Arithmetically average all original ddG_ML_float scores grouped by full final 64-aa mutated sequence; exclude WT; DMS_score_bin=int(DMS_score>=-1.271998543).
exact_reconstruction.note: This is an exactly independently reproduced transformation of published ProteinGym BBC1 source files, not retrieval of the authors' original preprocessing code. Older raw-only mismatch witnesses are historically valid as one-row comparisons but superseded as diagnoses of processed-score errors.

variant_constraints: one unmodified reference WT per domain
no BBC1 S2 variants or close homologs
no mutation selection using assay outcomes
freeze inclusion criteria before label access
independence_requirements: source and experimental assay data independent of Tsuboyama2023, ProteinGym derivatives and the S2 training labels
holdout generation or custodianship outside the JANUS model-fitting workflow
datasets and labels cannot be used by model training, hyperparameter selection, or protocol revision
screen model and source provider pretraining for potential data leakage or classify as nonblind
document assay and lab metadata, replicate counts, sequence IDs, accession, DOI, measurement units and transformation before unlock
prospective_trial.predictor: Use only exact frozen S2 coefficients. For each variant obtain comparable Boltz2 pTM and avg_lddt for matched wildtype and mutant with frozen provider version/sampling options; no retraining, recalibration, re-centering, target-dependent threshold or tuning.
prospective_trial.prediction_mode: Predictions from already-available or no-cost authorized verifiable provider evidence only; otherwise BLOCKED_NO_PREDICTIONS
frozen_prediction_receipt: candidate dataset identifiers and immutable accession/version/sha
unblinded input sequence ids and mutant ids but NOT labels
model parameters and full inference environment revision
complete per-variant signed predictions with SHA-256
timestamped external immutable GitHub checkpoint before label-release authorization
custodian attestation that unseen labels were not accessed in prediction or selection stages
prospective_trial.blinded_label_release: DO_NOT_UNLOCK_LABELS_OR_CALCULATE_A_PERFORMANCE_CLAIM. For public FireProt archive a retrospective leakage-controlled evaluation is possible only after complete sha-pinned real Boltz2 predictions, source-unit/signed score normalization proof, and independent data-handling attestation. For genuine prospective blind validation acquire newly measured undisclosed labels held by an independent custodian; source published 2023 cannot become prospectively blind by commit alone.
prospective_trial.primary_metric: Equal-domain-weighted mean absolute error on raw delta-delta stability kcal/mol
prospective_trial.primary_comparator: Pre-registered zero-change baseline: predict 0 kcal/mol for every mutation
secondary_metrics: per-domain direction accuracy excluding exactly zero labels (descriptive)
prospective_trial.uncertainty: Cluster bootstrap by domain, 10000 replicates, deterministic seed 20261025, CI percentile 2.5%-97.5% for macro-MAE difference and ratio
pass_criteria: sample sizes at least 10 independent domains and 200 variants, with at least 20 per domain
point estimate macro-MAE shadow <=0.90 * macro-MAE zero baseline
upper bound of 95% domain-cluster bootstrap confidence interval for MAE difference (shadow minus zero) is strictly below 0
prospective_trial.negative_result_policy: Fail or indeterminate result stays published; no refitting on same holdout, no posthoc rescue of the primary claim
exploratory_only_if: any label accessed before prediction freeze
confidence interval does not exclude zero

external_candidate.source: Dieckhaus et al., FireProtDB curated with experimental PDB structures, ThermoMPNN dataset

fireprot_feature_readiness.status_reason: Input frozen and 200 zero reference values frozen; RTX2070 CUDA found but no installed Boltz2, original Rowan avg_lddt equivalence unproven, no real 210 model score results, per-assay sign and independent new-label custodian unverified

governance.next_step: Implement and validate a no-cost single-chain Boltz2 smoke test on authorized CUDA hardware if resource limits allow, using a frozen BBC1 WT+variant feature-equivalence bridge first. Do NOT run 210 simulations until model/version normalization and no-cost hardware verified. Independently obtain unpublished prospective experimental results held by outside signatory; never mark existing public FireProt labels as truly blind. Do not change frozen S2 model, and no paid Rowan submissions.
governance.claim_boundary: Even a passing prospective benchmark would be evidence about quantitative assay prediction within sampled domains, not general protein fitness or self-improving AI.
